INSERT INTO sessions
            (id, restaurant_id, staff_id, token_hash, expires_at, last_seen_at,
             absolute_expires_at, updated_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4,
                now() + make_interval(secs => $5),
                now(),
                now() + make_interval(secs => $6),
                now())
        RETURNING expires_at, absolute_expires_at
